speaker: Damián
cn: 这不是我的工作范围吧，你应该找销售部的。
en: This isn't my job. You should contact the sales department.

speaker: Luis
cn: 能干就干，不能干就走人！我们信息部不要废人！
en: Either get it done or get out! We don’t need dead weight in the IT department!

speaker: Damián
cn: （淡淡）你最好真能叫我走人。（转身离开）
en: (With a faint tone) You’d better be damn sure you have the power to fire me. (Turns around and walks away)

speaker: Damián(VO)
cn: Samanta是总裁，到时候她肯定会帮我。
en: Samanta is the CEO. She will definitely have my back.

speaker: Margarita
cn: （大喊）Damián！Damián你给我出来！【人名：Margarita Roldán｜Eloísa母亲】
en: (yells) Damián! Damián, get outta here!

speaker: Eloísa
cn: （笑）爸妈，你们一会儿多帮我说说Damián。
en: (laughs) Mom, Dad, put in a good word for me with Damián later, okay?

speaker: Margarita
cn: 包在我们身上。
en: We'll take care of it.

speaker: Damián
cn: （淡淡）怎么有狗在叫？
en: (Quietly) What’s that? I hear a dog barking.

speaker: Margarita
cn: （怒）Damián你是不是疯了？当了组长就这么没礼貌！我看你是不想跟我女儿结婚了！【人名：Jairo Roldán｜Eloísa父亲】
en: (angry) Damián, have you lost your mind? You get promoted to team lead and suddenly you’ve got no manners? I guess you don’t want to marry my daughter anymore!

speaker: Damián
cn: （看Eloísa）Eloísa，你没告诉他们我已经结婚了？
en: (Looking at Eloísa) Eloísa, you didn't tell them that I'm already married?

speaker: Eloísa
cn: （不耐烦）Damián，你的谎话太假了，我们不会信的！
en: (impatient) Damián, quit lying—we won't believe that.

speaker: Jairo
cn: （点头）你现在立刻跪下，亲Eloísa的鞋头三下我们就立刻原谅你！
en: (nodding) Get on your knees and kiss Eloísa’s shoe three times. Do that, and we’ll forgive you on the spot.

speaker: Damián
cn: （无语）你们是不是脑子有毛病？别在这闹事了！（大叫）保安！带他们离开！
en: (Stunned) What the hell is wrong with you people? Stop making a scene! (shouts) Security! Get them out of here!

speaker: Eloísa
cn: （小声）你们先回去吧。过几天Damián肯定会回来求我的！你们先走吧。
en: (whispering) You two go home first. Just wait—Damián will be begging me to take him back in a few days. Go on.

speaker: Margarita
cn: Damián，我们走着瞧！
en: Damián, this isn’t over! Just you wait...

speaker: Damián
cn: 不对啊，应该让他们还钱啊。他们家装修都是我拿的钱！
en: Hold on. They owe me money! I paid for their entire home renovation!

speaker: 戒指（OS）
cn: （低沉，带回声）感应到新的命运节点：建筑工地。命运馈赠——力大无穷之力。
en: (deep, echoing) A new node of destiny has been detected: the construction site. Fate’s offering—the strength of a hundred men.

speaker: Damián
cn: （喜）这个能力来得倒是及时！正好拆了Eloísa她家！
en: (Happy) This ability arrives just in time! I'm just about to dismantle Eloísa's setup.

speaker: Damián
cn: （高声）借我用一下，一会儿还给你们！
en: (loudly) Let me borrow this for a moment. I'll give it back in a bit.

speaker: Jairo
cn: （不可思议）你疯了？这是我家！你在干什么？
en: (Incredulous) Are you crazy? This is my house! What are you doing here?
